notes: Mode-3 Codex maker. Tournament: 16016 strategy rows plus one benchmark valid=False; 10991 valid. Winner selected by ECON-T3 at step 1; 1 tied at Sharpe step. Bootstrap p=0.0813; CP1 durability=conditionally_durable; rolling correlation=moderately_stable. selection.rationale: Unique maximiser of OOS Sharpe over the full monthly grid L{0..12} (10991 valid combos, median OOS Sharpe 0.7982), scored on the deployable cash-filled series (ECON-T4). Winner raw OOS Sharpe 1.5273 at L11; the 2nd-best valid combo (petrol_6m/T3_zscore_1.0/P1_long_cash_pro/L11) sits at 1.5244. No ECON-T3 tie-break engaged (unique max on oos_sharpe). Published winner == raw max-OOS-Sharpe valid row -> divergence null.
